# Overwatch Retail Patch Notes - June 18, 2026

> 日期: 2026-06-18 · 站点: en · 来源: https://overwatch.blizzard.com/en-us/news/patch-notes/live/2026/06

## Bug Fix Patch

This is a Bug Fix Patch. Replay codes have NOT been wiped.

## Bug Fixes - General Game Updates

Resolved an issue with Shion's Joyride leaving collision behind for a period of time after throwing it at an enemy Resolved an issue with Kiriko's Ofuda range being set to the incorrect value Fixed an instance of Ramattra's Void Barrier's cooldown incorrectly resetting Fixed a bug with Shion's Joyride that allowed for bypassing of some animations Fixed bugs related to Domina's Corporate Retreat Resolved an issue that allowed Shion quick melee to be used during Satsuriku Spree

## Bug Fixes - Stadium Updates

Fixed an issue where Aerial Distresser was procing Ashe's Calamity Power more than intended. Fixed an issue where when using Tracer's Temportal Power, Interacting and Recalling at the same time would reset Recall's cooldown. Fixed an issue where healing from Winston's Surge Protector Power would continue longer than intended if Pocket Projector is active. Fixed an issue where Moira's Extendrils item prevented Ethereal Excision from granting bonus damage or healing. Fixed an issue where Three Tap Tommygun's DOT counted as Critical Hits for Cassidy's Bullseye Power and Kiriko's Keen Kunai Power. Fixed an issue where using Swift Strike right after Genji's Dragon Strike Item made players unable to use the rest of Dragon Blade. Fixed an issue where Sojourn's Overclocked Surge stats were not functional.
